title: ernodea littoralis var. angusta
intro: Ernodea littoralis var. angusta, commonly known as the Key West ernodea, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family, native to the southeastern United States, particularly in the Florida Keys. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Ernodea littoralis var. angusta include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic agent, making it useful for treating various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
